societies.name: Orion’s Arm — The Seams’ Dole-supported denizens
societies.society: A rudimentary universal floor across heterogeneous Seams economies

scope.period: Established Dole access under the Burdikeer
scope.population: Living humans and active human-derived denizens arriving in and inhabiting the Seams
exclusions: Every local market or government as identical
Crude support as luxurious Sephirotic abundance
Dormant files or repeated copies as extra residents

societies.description:
Every denizen arriving in the Seams receives Dole access to rudimentary food, shelter, clothing, transport and information. The card works through participating services, selected fabrication systems and housing authorities, and can even support stranded travelers. This is a durable technological basic-access mechanism across otherwise very different local economies. Guarantees are moderately strong for essentials, with low comfort, limited service participation and regional conditions preventing a claim of unrestricted abundance.

The Burdikeer is a constructed high-level tribemind assembled from archailect avatars and enforces the overarching framework. Effective authority over that common floor therefore lies near autonomous higher-machine control, while local ownership and politics remain diverse. A loose confederation does not automatically give ordinary humans final control of the sustaining system. Living humans and active human-derived residents are an explicit proxy within a broader population. Trade, exploration, care and industry continue, and a Dole card is not a census of people doing no useful work. Nonworking remains unresolved.

guarantees.basis: Every denizen receives a documented basic-access card accepted by affiliated fabrication/services/housing; modest quality and local conditions qualify the guarantee.

control.basis: The overarching floor is maintained by an independently governing constructed tribemind of archailect avatars; local political variety does not establish final human ownership.

nonworking.basis: No all-person useful-work census; receiving the Dole does not imply doing no trade, care, exploration or other useful work.

societies.name: Orion’s Arm — Cableville’s Ouroboros Social Webs
societies.society: Stable gift-economy communities with local productive control and shared high-level infrastructure

scope.continuity: Cableville, successful Social Web model in the official setting
scope.period: The established successful Social Webs after the experimental failures and before any specific major crisis
scope.population: Living humans and active human-derived residents participating in the Social Webs
exclusions: Neighboring Tuckerite markets or Wandering Hermits as this same regime
Dormant files or uncounted copies as people

societies.description:
Cableville’s successful Social Webs grow from communities supported by nanofabrication, bioforges and shared resources. They stabilize around gift economics and collective organization rather than ordinary wage purchases for every item. This supports a provisional favorable guarantee estimate for the selected communal model, with a broad interval because the reference does not define a complete universal necessities charter and other local cultures use different arrangements.

Residents control their own industries and use collective decision structures, while major industrial infrastructure and system-level ownership remain with higher minds. Control is consequently mixed: the estimate lies modestly toward human distribution, with an interval broad enough to reflect meaningful higher-level dependence. Local self-government is not equated with ownership of the entire habitat. Human and active human-derived residents are the disclosed population proxy. The culture explicitly values making and discovering things; enjoyable technical, artistic and social contributions remain work. Neither gift exchange nor successful communal life supplies a nonworking census, so participation stays null.
